CVE-2026-101384.affects: Oracle REST Data Services, Core component.
CVE-2026-101384.flaw: An easily exploited flaw in the Core component exposes data, and attacks can spill over into other products.
CVE-2026-101384.access: Remote over HTTP; the attacker needs a low-privilege account. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-101384.impact: The attacker can read a subset of the service's data. No data is changed and the service stays up.

CVE-2026-101678.flaw: An easily exploited flaw in the Java connector lets an outsider disrupt it.
CVE-2026-101678.access: Remote and unauthenticated, but someone other than the attacker has to take an action for it to work.
CVE-2026-101678.impact: The attacker can cause a partial outage of the connector. No data is read or changed.

CVE-2026-101729.affects: MySQL Server and MySQL Cluster, Replication component.
CVE-2026-101729.flaw: A flaw in the replication component lets a privileged user crash the server.
CVE-2026-101729.access: Remote over the network; the attacker needs a high-privilege account. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-101729.impact: The attacker can hang or repeatedly crash the server. No data is read or changed.

CVE-2026-103515.flaw: An admin's lock on AI feature availability isn't enforced at a fine enough level.
CVE-2026-103515.access: A logged-in user who is Owner of a group.
CVE-2026-103515.impact: Can turn AI data sharing with a third-party service back on for that group's projects.

CVE-2026-104353.flaw: OS command injection: input is passed to an operating system command without being neutralized.
CVE-2026-104353.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-104353.impact: The attacker can run arbitrary code as the current user, with effects reaching beyond the vulnerable component.

CVE-2026-105025.flaw: A double free: the same memory is released twice, corrupting memory.
CVE-2026-105025.access: Local; the attacker must already be an authorized user on the machine.
CVE-2026-105025.impact: The attacker can raise their privileges on the machine.

CVE-2026-105312.affects: A Kubernetes operator that deploys Console resources with cluster-wide access to Strimzi (Kafka) resources.
CVE-2026-105312.flaw: A tenant can set the Console's container image to any image, which then runs under a highly privileged service account.
CVE-2026-105312.access: The attacker must be a Kubernetes tenant allowed to create Console custom resources.
CVE-2026-105312.impact: The attacker's code steals the service account token and gains cross-tenant read and write control over Strimzi resources.

CVE-2026-105614.affects: The PostgreSQL Anonymizer extension's image blur function.
CVE-2026-105614.flaw: The image blur function trusts an image's declared size, so a tiny image can claim enormous dimensions.
CVE-2026-105614.access: The attacker must be able to call the image blur function with an image they supply.
CVE-2026-105614.impact: The attacker can exhaust a backend's memory and force a cluster-wide crash recovery.

CVE-2026-105702.flaw: Error messages expose internal implementation details.
CVE-2026-105702.access: Remote; the attacker must be logged in.
CVE-2026-105702.impact: The attacker can obtain sensitive information about the system's internals.

CVE-2026-106174.flaw: An improper locking bug lets crafted HTTP requests jam the management interface.
CVE-2026-106174.access: Remote and unauthenticated, with network access to the device.
CVE-2026-106174.impact: The attacker can knock the HTTPS management interface offline.

CVE-2026-107307.affects: The SmartLinker AI module for Drupal.
CVE-2026-107307.flaw: Incorrect authorization lets someone reach pages or functions just by requesting them directly (forceful browsing).
CVE-2026-107307.impact: The attacker can reach resources they aren't authorized for; further impact isn't published.

CVE-2026-108762.affects: Apache Kylin, mainly instances exposed directly to the public internet.
CVE-2026-108762.flaw: A path-confinement bypass during metadata backup deletion lets operations escape the intended directory.
CVE-2026-108762.access: Not published; the advisory says internal deployments are mostly not affected.
CVE-2026-108762.impact: Not detailed beyond escaping the backup directory during deletion.

CVE-2026-109618.flaw: After an out-of-memory error, PHP can leave request memory uninitialized and later read it.
CVE-2026-109618.access: Remote, by sending requests that reliably push PHP into out-of-memory conditions.
CVE-2026-109618.impact: Remote code execution on the web server.

CVE-2026-109619.flaw: Global state can keep pointing at freed request memory, which later requests then use.
CVE-2026-109619.access: Remote, by sending sequences of requests that trigger the stale state.
CVE-2026-109619.impact: Remote code execution on the web server.

CVE-2026-109796.affects: SAP NetWeaver Application Server ABAP and ABAP Platform.
CVE-2026-109796.flaw: Some internal components don't initialize memory before using it.
CVE-2026-109796.access: The attacker needs a low-privilege account, and specific conditions must be met.
CVE-2026-109796.impact: The attacker can read limited leftover memory contents. Integrity and availability are not affected.

CVE-2026-110183.affects: PostgreSQL Anonymizer, when static masking is used.
CVE-2026-110183.flaw: After static masking, statistics about the original data stay visible in pg_stats until the table is analyzed.
CVE-2026-110183.access: Not published; the attacker needs to be able to read the pg_stats view.
CVE-2026-110183.impact: The attacker can learn statistics about data that was supposed to be masked.

CVE-2026-111302.flaw: A heap-based buffer overflow when handling content.
CVE-2026-111302.access: No login needed; the code runs locally, typically once a victim opens a malicious file.
CVE-2026-111302.impact: The attacker can execute code on the victim's machine.

CVE-2026-111503.flaw: SQL injection: input is placed into a database query without being neutralized.
CVE-2026-111503.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account.
CVE-2026-111503.impact: The attacker can expose information from the system.

CVE-2026-112207.affects: The Download Monitor plugin for WordPress.
CVE-2026-112207.flaw: The plugin fetches a clicked link without checking it belongs to the site, then renders part of the response in the page.
CVE-2026-112207.access: Remote and unauthenticated, but a user must be tricked into clicking a crafted link.
CVE-2026-112207.impact: The attacker can run JavaScript in the victim's browser on the site.

CVE-2026-112381.flaw: A timing-dependent race leads to a null pointer dereference when a POST request is torn down mid-response.
CVE-2026-112381.access: Remote; a client must win a timing race. Authentication isn't mentioned.
CVE-2026-112381.impact: The attacker can crash the server.

CVE-2026-112937.affects: The filelock Python library's ReadWriteLock, in a shared directory without the sticky bit.
CVE-2026-112937.flaw: Cleanup can delete a private lock directory, and another user can swap names to steer that deletion.
CVE-2026-112937.access: Local; another user on the same system with rename rights in the parent directory.
CVE-2026-112937.impact: The attacker can get a sibling directory deleted.

CVE-2026-113026.affects: Google Chrome on Android, PDF handling.
CVE-2026-113026.flaw: Information loss in PDF handling lets a page get around the browser's web origin policy.
CVE-2026-113026.access: Remote; the victim must load a crafted HTML page.
CVE-2026-113026.impact: The attacker can bypass the origin policy that keeps sites apart.

CVE-2026-113032.affects: Google Chrome on Android, address bar (Omnibox).
CVE-2026-113032.flaw: Improper input validation in the address bar lets a co-installed app get around the web origin policy.
CVE-2026-113032.access: Local; a malicious app must be installed on the device and the user socially engineered.
CVE-2026-113032.impact: The attacker can bypass the origin policy that keeps sites apart.

CVE-2026-113061.flaw: Improper input validation in Chromoting lets crafted network traffic get around access restrictions.
CVE-2026-113061.access: Remote; the user must be socially engineered.
CVE-2026-113061.impact: The attacker can bypass system access restrictions.

CVE-2026-113272.flaw: Incorrect authorization in Extensions lets a crafted extension break out of the sandbox.
CVE-2026-113272.access: Remote; the attacker must already control the renderer process and socially engineer the user.
CVE-2026-113272.impact: The attacker can potentially run code outside the browser sandbox.

CVE-2026-113408.flaw: Path traversal lets a malicious repository write outside where it should.
CVE-2026-113408.access: The victim must clone and commit to a malicious repository.
CVE-2026-113408.impact: The attacker can write to an arbitrary file.

CVE-2026-113580.flaw: Code injection: input ends up being run as code.
CVE-2026-113580.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-113580.impact: The attacker can run arbitrary code as the current user, with effects reaching beyond the vulnerable component.

CVE-2026-113659.affects: ApostropheCMS admin pages (anonymous visitors aren't affected).
CVE-2026-113659.flaw: The query-string parser accepts prototype keys, letting a link modify JavaScript objects and reach an unsafe page sink.
CVE-2026-113659.access: Unauthenticated attacker, but a logged-in user must open a crafted link.
CVE-2026-113659.impact: The attacker can run script in the victim's admin session.

CVE-2026-113733.flaw: Password fields on some custom user models aren't hidden on read-only admin pages.
CVE-2026-113733.access: A logged-in staff user with view-only permission on that model.
CVE-2026-113733.impact: Can read full password hashes, which can then be cracked offline.

CVE-2026-114452.affects: The Membership Plugin for WordPress, saved-card payments.
CVE-2026-114452.flaw: A saved-card payment request isn't checked to belong to the user making it.
CVE-2026-114452.access: Remote; the attacker needs a subscriber-level account.
CVE-2026-114452.impact: The attacker can read another member's Stripe payment secret and attach their own payment method to that member's payment.

CVE-2026-114643.affects: MongoDB C# Driver, in apps that put user-supplied field names into GeoJSON extra members.
CVE-2026-114643.flaw: The driver writes extra GeoJSON fields without checking they don't collide with reserved ones like type or coordinates.
CVE-2026-114643.access: The attacker must be able to supply field names that the application stores.
CVE-2026-114643.impact: The attacker can create records the server and driver read differently, or that the driver can't read at all.

CVE-2026-114649.affects: MongoDB C# Driver, in apps that create clients from certificates supplied by different users.
CVE-2026-114649.flaw: Cached connections are shared based only on a certificate's issuer and serial number.
CVE-2026-114649.access: The attacker must supply a certificate copying another user's issuer and serial number; no private key needed.
CVE-2026-114649.impact: The attacker can run database operations as the other user, reading and changing that user's data.

CVE-2026-114655.affects: libmongocrypt (MongoDB encryption library), when using AWS, Azure or GCP key management.
CVE-2026-114655.flaw: Requests to key management services are built from stored values without validation or encoding.
CVE-2026-114655.access: The attacker needs write access to the key vault collection.
CVE-2026-114655.impact: The attacker can make key management operations run with parameters the app didn't intend, signed with its credentials.

CVE-2026-114728.flaw: The remote-content filter misses some CSS escape spellings, so blocked content in an HTML email still loads.
CVE-2026-114728.access: Remote and unauthenticated; the victim has to open a crafted email.
CVE-2026-114728.impact: The attacker can load remote content without the user's consent, for example to see that an email was opened.

CVE-2026-116153.flaw: An integer overflow leads to a heap buffer overflow.
CVE-2026-116153.access: Anyone who can get a crafted image processed with convex-hull info requested.
CVE-2026-116153.impact: Corrupts memory: crashes, and possibly code execution.

CVE-2026-116159.affects: ImageMagick, when the color decision list (-cdl) option is processed.
CVE-2026-116159.flaw: A memory leak: memory used by the -cdl option is never freed.
CVE-2026-116159.access: The attacker must supply input that causes the -cdl option to be processed.
CVE-2026-116159.impact: The attacker can repeatedly leak memory until the system slows or fails.

CVE-2026-116310.affects: PostgreSQL COPY FROM (and file_fdw); older major versions are not affected.
CVE-2026-116310.flaw: A use-after-free in COPY FROM error reporting.
CVE-2026-116310.access: The attacker must be a database user able to run COPY FROM.
CVE-2026-116310.impact: The attacker can read portions of server memory.

CVE-2026-117621.flaw: Cross-site scripting: link URLs in the workspace browser are computed on the agent, which can inject script.
CVE-2026-117621.access: The attacker must control a Jenkins agent process.
CVE-2026-117621.impact: The attacker can run script in the browsers of users viewing the workspace.

CVE-2026-118100.flaw: Form export doesn't check that the requester is allowed to manage the form.
CVE-2026-118100.impact: The attacker can download any form's settings, including notification email addresses and reCAPTCHA secret keys.

CVE-2026-118527.impact: Can place files with their own content at a known location on the appliance.

CVE-2026-118541.flaw: Incorrect authorization lets someone reach pages or functions just by requesting them directly (forceful browsing).
CVE-2026-118541.impact: The attacker can reach resources they aren't authorized for; further impact isn't published.

CVE-2026-119303.flaw: One REST route has no permission or nonce check.
CVE-2026-119303.impact: The attacker can change one plugin option and repeatedly trigger emails from the site's mail server.

CVE-2026-119673.flaw: Download paths don't resolve symlinked parent folders.
CVE-2026-119673.access: Must upload a stored file, plant a symlink in the operator's folder, then wait for a download.
CVE-2026-119673.impact: A later download writes attacker data to a file outside the intended folder.

CVE-2026-119929.flaw: A use-after-free: memory is used after it has been released.
CVE-2026-119929.access: Local; the attacker must already be an authorized user on the machine.
CVE-2026-119929.impact: The attacker can raise their privileges on the machine.

CVE-2026-119944.access: Remote over a network, without authorization.
CVE-2026-119944.impact: The attacker can raise their privileges.

CVE-2026-119977.flaw: Upgrades unpack to predictable, web-reachable staging paths, leaving a race window.
CVE-2026-119977.access: Remote, no login needed, but only while a core upgrade is running.
CVE-2026-119977.impact: Can run code on the web server.

CVE-2026-120012.flaw: Some failures write authentication credentials into error messages.
CVE-2026-120012.access: Low-privilege access to logs, plus waiting for a failure triggered by a higher-privileged user before the token expires.
CVE-2026-120012.impact: The attacker can reuse the leaked credentials against the SAP service, reading, changing or disrupting it.

CVE-2026-120244.flaw: When input ends early, the decoder leaves buffer bytes uncleared.
CVE-2026-120244.access: The attacker must get a crafted, truncated PCX image decoded.
CVE-2026-120244.impact: The attacker can leak heap memory contents through the decoded pixels.

CVE-2026-120423.affects: undici, the Node.js HTTP client, when fetch uses Subresource Integrity with extra whitespace.
CVE-2026-120423.flaw: Integrity metadata is split only on spaces, so a tab-separated digest is ignored and the check passes.
CVE-2026-120423.access: The attacker must control the response body; no need to touch the integrity value.
CVE-2026-120423.impact: The app accepts attacker-controlled content as if it matched its pinned digest.

CVE-2026-121181.access: Remote; the victim must load a crafted HTML page.
CVE-2026-121181.impact: The attacker can execute code inside the browser sandbox.

CVE-2026-121349.flaw: Path traversal: file paths aren't limited to the intended directory.
CVE-2026-121349.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-121349.impact: The attacker can gain elevated access or take over a victim's account or session, with effects beyond the component.

CVE-2026-121415.flaw: Field type validation is skipped for null-valued dot-notation keys.
CVE-2026-121415.access: Any client with write access, including anonymous clients if public writes are allowed.
CVE-2026-121415.impact: Can corrupt field values, make objects unreadable, or break counters.

CVE-2026-121673.flaw: A use-after-free: memory is used after it has been released.
CVE-2026-121673.access: Local; the attacker must already be an authorized user on the machine.
CVE-2026-121673.impact: The attacker can raise their privileges on the machine.

CVE-2026-122003.affects: The Abilities Bridge plugin for WordPress.
CVE-2026-122003.flaw: Cross-site request forgery: REST requests are re-authenticated from the session cookie without a valid nonce.
CVE-2026-122003.access: Remote; a logged-in administrator must be tricked into opening a crafted page.
CVE-2026-122003.impact: The attacker can make the admin perform any REST action, such as creating a new admin and taking over the site.

CVE-2026-123158.affects: OpenSSH server on Linux with musl libc and no PAM (e.g. Alpine Linux)
CVE-2026-123158.flaw: The password check misreads some inputs as password hashes.
CVE-2026-123158.access: Remote, no login needed, but only for certain account configurations.
CVE-2026-123158.impact: Any password 256 to 1024 characters long logs in to the affected accounts.

CVE-2026-123218.flaw: Authorization bypass via a crafted message.

CVE-2026-12356.flaw: Malicious arguments can be injected into Ant script commands.
CVE-2026-12356.access: The attacker must be logged in with access to the command queue.
CVE-2026-12356.impact: The attacker can execute arbitrary code.

CVE-2026-124194.flaw: Doesn't warn the user before an unsafe action.
CVE-2026-124194.access: No login needed; Microsoft lists the attack as coming over the network.
CVE-2026-124194.impact: Can spoof content to deceive the user.

CVE-2026-125100.flaw: An integer overflow miscounts tiled blocks, so decoding is skipped.
CVE-2026-125100.access: The attacker must get a crafted tiled OpenEXR image decoded.
CVE-2026-125100.impact: The attacker can disclose uninitialized memory or stale frame data.

CVE-2026-125120.affects: Mongoose (MongoDB library for Node.js), in apps that rely on sanitizeFilter with countDocuments.
CVE-2026-125120.flaw: countDocuments() skips the sanitizeFilter defense against query operator injection.
CVE-2026-125120.access: The attacker must be able to pass filter values the app sends to countDocuments().
CVE-2026-125120.impact: The attacker can skew counts, potentially undermining authorization or logic built on them.

CVE-2026-125206.affects: FFmpeg (ProRes 4444 encoder with transparency, interlaced video)
CVE-2026-125206.flaw: Out-of-bounds read on odd-height interlaced frames.
CVE-2026-125206.access: Supply crafted video with a transparency channel for the app to encode.
CVE-2026-125206.impact: Leaks memory into the output's transparency plane.

CVE-2026-125217.flaw: Flushing the encoder early encodes uninitialized heap memory.
CVE-2026-125217.access: The attacker must get a short audio stream transcoded to RoQ DPCM.
CVE-2026-125217.impact: The attacker can leak heap memory contents into the output file.

CVE-2026-125243.flaw: Certain 16-bit scans are decoded as 8-bit, leaving part of the frame uninitialized.
CVE-2026-125243.access: The attacker must get a crafted JPEG-LS image decoded.
CVE-2026-125243.impact: The attacker can expose leftover heap memory in the decoded image.

CVE-2026-125258.affects: FFmpeg's Dolby Vision encoding path (dovi_rpu filter and the x265, aom and SVT-AV1 encoders).
CVE-2026-125258.flaw: A division by zero from an unchecked frame-rate denominator.
CVE-2026-125258.access: The attacker must get a crafted HEVC or AV1 input processed.
CVE-2026-125258.impact: The attacker can crash the process.

CVE-2026-125341.affects: Winter CMS backend, only with certain third-party plugins
CVE-2026-125341.flaw: Image list values are placed in the page without escaping (stored XSS).
CVE-2026-125341.access: Must get an attacker-influenced value into an image list column.
CVE-2026-125341.impact: Script runs when a backend user views the list. Default installs aren't affected.

CVE-2026-125350.access: The victim visits a malicious web page.

CVE-2026-126390.affects: n8n's NocoDB node, with Download Attachments enabled.
CVE-2026-126390.flaw: The node sends its NocoDB API token to whatever host an attachment URL points to.
CVE-2026-126390.access: The attacker needs write access to a NocoDB attachment cell, then waits for the workflow to run.
CVE-2026-126390.impact: The attacker can capture the NocoDB API token.

CVE-2026-12660.flaw: Improper path validation lets files be written outside the intended directory.
CVE-2026-12660.access: The attacker must be logged in as an administrator.
CVE-2026-12660.impact: The attacker can write files outside the intended directory.

CVE-2026-128086.affects: OpenTelemetry-Go, when baggage extraction runs on untrusted input before authentication.
CVE-2026-128086.flaw: Parsing a dense baggage header allocates far more memory than the header's size.
CVE-2026-128086.access: Remote; the attacker's header must reach baggage extraction, e.g. on a public route.
CVE-2026-128086.impact: The attacker can raise memory and garbage-collection pressure; a reliable crash isn't established.

CVE-2026-128088.affects: russh, a Rust SSH library (SSH agent)
CVE-2026-128088.flaw: A signing request doesn't recheck the agent's lock state after waiting for confirmation.
CVE-2026-128088.access: A peer, such as a remote server using agent forwarding, with a request already pending.
CVE-2026-128088.impact: Can get a signature after the agent was locked. Private keys aren't exposed.

CVE-2026-129296.affects: The mail-parser Python library, when an app extracts attachments.
CVE-2026-129296.flaw: Attachment filenames aren't sanitized, so traversal sequences or absolute paths escape the output folder.
CVE-2026-129296.access: The attacker sends a crafted email that the application extracts.
CVE-2026-129296.impact: The attacker can overwrite files the parsing process can access.

CVE-2026-16240.flaw: Format string bug driven by the server's backup manifest.
CVE-2026-16240.access: The attacker must already control the database server being backed up.
CVE-2026-16240.impact: Makes the backup client read its own memory; nothing is sent back to the attacker.

CVE-2026-16884.impact: The attacker can obtain sensitive information.

CVE-2026-17345.flaw: SQL injection: input is placed into a database query without being neutralized.
CVE-2026-17345.access: Remote; the attacker must be logged in.
CVE-2026-17345.impact: The attacker can obtain sensitive information.

CVE-2026-18128.affects: The agent of Ivanti Endpoint Manager.
CVE-2026-18128.flaw: The agent sends sensitive information over unencrypted HTTP.
CVE-2026-18128.access: Unauthenticated, but the attacker must be in a man-in-the-middle position on the network.
CVE-2026-18128.impact: The attacker can read and modify the agent's traffic.

CVE-2026-28328.flaw: Broken authorization lets users act beyond their assigned permissions.
CVE-2026-28328.access: The attacker needs a low-privilege account.
CVE-2026-28328.impact: The attacker can view and modify information they shouldn't have access to.

CVE-2026-48830.affects: Apache bRPC, with authentication on and built-in HTTP services on the public listener.
CVE-2026-48830.flaw: A built-in request sent first on a keep-alive connection marks the whole connection as authenticated.
CVE-2026-48830.impact: The attacker can reach protected HTTP endpoints without logging in.

CVE-2026-58663.flaw: An authentication bypass in the RPC service.
CVE-2026-58663.impact: The attacker can get past authentication; further impact isn't published.

CVE-2026-62011.flaw: PHP object injection: untrusted data is turned back into PHP objects.

CVE-2026-62014.flaw: PHP object injection: untrusted data is turned back into PHP objects.

CVE-2026-62131.flaw: PHP object injection: untrusted data is turned back into PHP objects.

CVE-2026-76287.affects: Splunk Enterprise, only with the Edge Processor feature turned on (off by default).
CVE-2026-76287.flaw: The Data Management API checks capabilities but not whether a preview job belongs to the requester.
CVE-2026-76287.access: The attacker needs a role with the data management pipeline preview or edit capability.
CVE-2026-76287.impact: The attacker can read or delete other users' preview jobs and results.

CVE-2026-76308.flaw: The REST API authenticates but doesn't authorize requests to change the Enterprise Security edition.
CVE-2026-76308.impact: The attacker can change the Enterprise Security edition and get SOAR to apply the license change.

CVE-2026-76418.affects: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA and FTD (remote access VPN with secondary authentication)
CVE-2026-76418.flaw: Logic error when secondary authentication is set up on a tunnel group.
CVE-2026-76418.access: Remote, no login needed: a crafted VPN connection request.
CVE-2026-76418.impact: Reloads the firewall, causing an outage.

CVE-2026-77777.flaw: Improper access control on ACME certificate deployment settings.
CVE-2026-77777.access: The attacker must be logged in.
CVE-2026-77777.impact: The attacker can change another user's ACME certificate deployment credentials.

CVE-2026-82154.access: Physical access to the device, no login needed.

CVE-2026-82953.affects: Apache bRPC RTMP servers whose service can reject createStream requests.
CVE-2026-82953.flaw: A null pointer dereference when a rejected createStream response can't be sent.
CVE-2026-82953.access: Remote; the client sends createStream and immediately disconnects. No login is mentioned.
CVE-2026-82953.impact: The attacker can crash the server.

CVE-2026-84916.flaw: Missing authorization check, allowing forceful browsing.
CVE-2026-84916.access: Remote; the required access level isn't published.
CVE-2026-84916.impact: Users can go straight to pages they shouldn't be able to reach.

CVE-2026-86364.flaw: Values that need to be unpredictable aren't random enough.
CVE-2026-86364.access: Local; the attacker needs a low-privilege account.

CVE-2026-86365.access: Local; the attacker needs a low-privilege account.
CVE-2026-86365.impact: The attacker can cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-86391.affects: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain Management Center.
CVE-2026-86391.flaw: Authentication can be bypassed by spoofing.
CVE-2026-86391.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account.
CVE-2026-86391.impact: The attacker can cause a denial of service.

CVE-2026-86396.flaw: OS command injection: input is passed to an operating system command without being neutralized.
CVE-2026-86396.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account.
CVE-2026-86396.impact: The attacker can execute commands on the system.

CVE-2026-87330.affects: Oracle JD Edwards EnterpriseOne Tools on UNIX.
CVE-2026-87330.flaw: An easily exploited flaw in the development platform.
CVE-2026-87330.access: Local; the attacker needs a high-privilege login to the host running the software.
CVE-2026-87330.impact: The attacker can read and change some data and cause a partial outage.

CVE-2026-87951.access: The required access level isn't published.
CVE-2026-87951.impact: Lets an attacker retrieve embedded sensitive data.

CVE-2026-87953.affects: The SAML SSO - Service Provider module for Drupal.
CVE-2026-87953.flaw: Server-side request forgery: the server can be made to send requests to places it shouldn't.
CVE-2026-87953.impact: The attacker can make the server send requests on their behalf; further impact isn't published.

CVE-2026-90628.flaw: Uncontrolled memory access when exporting a document with a crafted CFF font causes a stack overflow.
CVE-2026-90628.access: The victim must export a document containing the crafted font to PDF.
CVE-2026-90628.impact: The attacker can crash the program, corrupt memory, or possibly run code.

CVE-2026-91163.affects: Warpgate bastion host's Kubernetes protocol listener.
CVE-2026-91163.flaw: Authentication failures return internal diagnostics in the error response and skip the gateway log.
CVE-2026-91163.impact: The attacker learns internal diagnostics unlogged. No user data, integrity or availability impact is established.

CVE-2026-91340.affects: Oracle Outside In Technology, Clean Content SDK.
CVE-2026-91340.flaw: An easily exploited flaw in the Clean Content SDK.
CVE-2026-91340.access: Remote over HTTP; the attacker needs a low-privilege account. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-91340.impact: The attacker can take over Oracle Outside In Technology.

CVE-2026-91364.affects: Oracle Siebel CRM Cloud Applications, Siebel Cloud Manager.
CVE-2026-91364.flaw: A hard-to-exploit flaw in Siebel Cloud Manager.
CVE-2026-91364.access: Unauthenticated, but the attacker must be on the same physical network segment.
CVE-2026-91364.impact: The attacker can read and change all accessible data. The service stays up.

CVE-2026-91398.affects: Oracle Java SE and GraalVM, Networking component (SOCKS5), including sandboxed apps running untrusted code.
CVE-2026-91398.flaw: A hard-to-exploit networking flaw reachable through SOCKS5, with effects beyond Java itself.
CVE-2026-91398.access: Remote and unauthenticated. No user interaction is needed.
CVE-2026-91398.impact: The attacker can create, delete or change accessible data. No data is read and the service stays up.

CVE-2026-91547.flaw: An easily exploited flaw in the Vendor Access Module.
CVE-2026-91547.access: Local; the attacker needs a low-privilege login to the host running GoldenGate.
CVE-2026-91547.impact: The attacker can read all GoldenGate-accessible data. No data is changed and the service stays up.

CVE-2026-95745.flaw: A flaw in the API lets an outsider disrupt it.
CVE-2026-95745.impact: The attacker can make the management services unavailable.

CVE-2026-95776.flaw: Path traversal in the API, exploitable only when certain conditions outside the attacker's control are met.
CVE-2026-95776.access: Remote; the attacker needs a low-privilege account.
CVE-2026-95776.impact: The attacker can read certain files on the underlying operating system.

CVE-2026-96384.affects: The Mermaid Diagram Field module for Drupal.
CVE-2026-96384.flaw: Incorrect authorization lets someone reach pages or functions just by requesting them directly (forceful browsing).
CVE-2026-96384.impact: The attacker can reach resources they aren't authorized for; further impact isn't published.

CVE-2026-96637.affects: Pillow, the Python imaging library (SPIDER images)
CVE-2026-96637.flaw: The oversized-image safety check is skipped on later frames.
CVE-2026-96637.access: Anyone who can get an app to open their image file.
CVE-2026-96637.impact: A tiny file can consume gigabytes of memory and stall the app.

CVE-2026-99030.affects: Linux kernel networking (skbuff), in ICMP error replies and some drivers' transmit buffers.
CVE-2026-99030.flaw: When copying stops early, the rest of an outgoing buffer is left holding stale memory.
CVE-2026-99030.access: Not published; the leak happens in packets the system sends on the network.
CVE-2026-99030.impact: Leftover kernel memory can be sent out in packets, though receivers usually drop them.
